entries.title: Record Switcher empty search state.

entries.title: Record Switcher cross-site page suggestions.
entries.notes: The guarded fixture prepares accessible pages on two sites for a global administrator. Search for Partner guide and require the actual Other sites group; a tenant-scoped actor is refused.

notCaptured.reason: Not captured: the real in-repo runner was blocked before navigation on 2026-08-16 when the all-package workbench install failed with missing Capell\ThemeBistro\ThemeBistroServiceProvider autoloading. This non-required light/dark pair was removed rather than fabricated.

An unavailable resource deliberately hides the switcher. Waiting for .filament-record-switcher could only capture an available control, so this image cannot prove the former claim. Absence and inaccessible endpoints remain covered by the Livewire tests.
